benchmark.name: Sequential SfM vs COLMAP head-to-head (metric video)
benchmark.protocol: Same rectified EuRoC MH_03_medium 2700-frame stereo image stream reconstructed by both engines and scored against the same timestamped Vicon/Leica ground truth with the same evo_ape tooling (DROID/DPVO same-tool battle pattern). visloc arm: stereo VO + online windowed BA + loop-closure pose-graph optimization -> merged multi-view tracks -> COLMAP model export (stereo_vo_external_deep_files --sfm-colmap-out), metric scale by construction from the rectified stereo baseline. COLMAP arm: monocular sequential_matcher + incremental mapper (SIFT frontend), scale-free, Sim(3)-aligned to ground truth.

params.export_ba_iterations_note: deliberate 5-iteration cap on the COLMAP-model export BA so it polishes structure without re-deforming the loop-closed trajectory; a full 30-iteration export BA reaches 0.94px reprojection but pulls trajectory ATE out to 0.21m

dataset.name: EuRoC MAV
dataset.version: ASL EuRoC MAV dataset, full 2700 frames

hardware.notes: Single CPU machine; no CUDA involved in either arm.

metrics.implementation: visloc stereo VO + online windowed BA + loop-closure pose-graph optimization + merged multi-view tracks + COLMAP model export
metrics.name: wall_clock

metrics.implementation: evo_ape, Sim(3) alignment against Vicon/Leica ground truth, scored on the exported COLMAP model
metrics.name: ate_sim3

metrics.implementation: evo_ape, SE(3) rigid alignment against Vicon/Leica ground truth, scored on the loop-closed VO trajectory before COLMAP-model export
metrics.name: ate_se3_metric

notes: Phase 2 registry formalization of the existing sequential SfM vs COLMAP head-to-head documented in docs/sfm_vs_colmap_benchmark.md (EuRoC MH_03_medium, full 2700 frames). This is the visloc-rs arm: stereo VO + loop-closure SfM, metric scale by construction. The 2.60px mean_reprojection is a deliberate knob (5-iteration COLMAP-export BA cap), not an accuracy ceiling -- a full 30-iteration export BA reaches 0.94px reprojection but pulls trajectory ATE out to 0.21m (the reprojection-vs-ATE tension documented in the source doc). downstream_3dgs="blurry" reflects a fly-through capture-geometry limit, not a pose defect: the same forward-flight geometry produces blur for any pose source including COLMAP, whereas the V2_03 orbit sequence (better capture geometry) renders crisp (l1 ~= 0.006) and this same MH_03/MH_05-style forward-flight blur (l1 ~= 0.24 on MH_05) is a capture-geometry property, not something covisibility or loop-closure quality changes. Numbers are taken verbatim from docs/sfm_vs_colmap_benchmark.md; not re-run in this session (this is a fast, cheap arm -- 6 minutes -- so a re-run is plausible in principle, but this manifest formalizes the already-documented result rather than re-executing it).
